# RINGFALL: CHAOS CIRCUIT
Local-first 3D wrestling game with articulated physics in the Volt Dome. Fresh local setup defaults to Singles; five-wrestler Battle Royale is also available. Explore Showground adds a connected yard, backstage and ringside with nearby bout offers and device-local saves. Six encounters open physical bouts in the backyard, backstage or Volt Dome and return to the grounds. Earn device-local circuit reputation and mastery medals to unlock harder rivals. Exploration and combat use separate scenes; seamless combat and cloud progression are not implemented.
Public game: /
Health: /api/health
API docs: /api/docs
OpenAPI: /openapi.yaml
Characters, music, crowd audio and original FRWF background footage load as bundled assets. Local matches need no login. The optional online client uses a separately configured Colyseus service; production availability and gameplay parity require independent verification. The separate Cloudflare backend is not wired into this browser client. Static frontend discovery does not certify gameplay quality or backend deployment.
